text: Theo briefs CTO Dana Whitfield and VP of Engineering Casey Lindqvist on the sale's overall results and the incident together, in the same conversation — not as a success story with a footnote.

The briefing leads with business impact, not technical sequence: roughly eighty-five minutes of degraded checkout during peak traffic, then the real mechanism in plain language — a missing topology spread constraint, masked by a cluster-wide average.
Theo is careful not to overclaim. checkout-api is fixed and validated. That's not the same as every other service being free of the same gap — the broader review is still an open follow-up.

He names the hardest likely question himself: why didn't the FinOps dashboard catch this sooner. He explains its real blind spot, and the new panel and alert that now close it. Next lesson: presenting the full after-action report to the wider team.
